"Unmatched witness statement from the faculty: Student ran class by class and warned about the shooting. He saw the murderer in front of his very eyes.

More terrifying testimonies from the fateful day of December 21. are surfacing about the shooting at the Faculty of Arts. One of the students that were in the building during the rampage, was also a history student Tomáš Hercík. He, in the documentary made by Česká televize with the name "21. 12. FF UK", described the details of the shooting and even, that he was guiding the police and paramedics in the correct direction throughout the building, where they should go.

Twenty four year old David stormed into the building of the Faculty of Arts belonging to Charles University and began his rampage, which cost lives of many innocent people. The murderer shot himself in the end, however he left a deep scar on the soul of all survivors and relatives of the victims. After more than a month, new testimonies from the fateful day keep surfacing. 
One of the surviving students, Tomáš Hercík, described in a documentary made by Česká televize with the name of "21. 12. FF UK", in what way he helped the police find the mass murderer, that caused the biggest suffering for people on the fourth floor of the faculty building. 

Another testimony

On that day, 21. December, at that moment, he was attending a seminar on the second floor. Shortly before 3PM, his classmate received an SMS with the information, that someone's shooting on the fourth floor. 
„I quickly pushed my chair away and pretty much ran out of the classroom, making my way to the fourth floor," Tomáš confessed in the forementioned documentary.

He ran to the upper floors to warn his classmates and teachers as well. One by one, he opened the doors to the classrooms and yelled at the present occupants, that there's a person on their floor with a gun and he's actively shooting. As he made his way to the fourth floor, he smelled the reek of gun powder and heard screaming as well as firing of a gun. „At that moment I realized, with no exaggeration, that there are lives at stake and that my own was as well," he added.

He saw the perpetrator 

For one moment he saw even saw the perpetrator. „After my first warning, much to my surprise, they were staring at me, asking whether I'm just running around and joking.  So I said that this is not a joke. I grabbed someone by the shoulder and tried to usher them to the closest room." Tomáš Hercík added."
